job_spec.structural_change: kc3 pin plan: the kc2 route crashed twice in pin placement (PPL-0093: an ordered group of 23, kvn[1046:1024], did not fit the LEFT region: 1,623 pins x 2 M4 tracks = 155.8 um of the 162 um face left no contiguous run after the corner bands). Every port now has its own disjoint range on its face and the pins are placed one by one (place_pin, uniform, >= 2 M4 tracks apart) on the spans the qkd_seq cluster's W / E pins use (aq 1.0-53.0, kvn 54.0-155.0 = cluster span minus the fan origin), E face in the same bit order straight across the tile; no PPL groups. RTL unchanged. kc4: kc3 placed its pins and passed CTS, then failed global route by ONE track in 66 gcells, all in the column x 7.98-8.55 um behind the W (output) face (GRT-0116; M2 54 % / M4 24 % overall): at 2.8 pins per cell row the FIRM pin flops (4 columns, x 3.2-8.3) sat on top of the three FIRM hold-stage cells of every output pin (BUF -> HB4 -> BUF, 1.4 um a pin), and legalisation interleaved them, so every flop -> hold -> pin chain crossed that column more than once. Now the pin flops start 4.5 um inside the core (OT_OFLOP_GAP) in 6 columns: hold stages at the pins (x 2.2-6.7), flops behind them (x 6.7-14.3), one monotonic crossing per net. RTL, outline and pin positions unchanged.
